title: scTrilemma: Balancing Identity, Invariance, and Fidelity in Single-Cell Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-cell RNA-seq representation learning is fundamentally label-free: cell identities, states, and contexts are not fixed training targets, so what constitutes signal or nuisance is analysis-dependent. A single representation must therefore preserve biological identity and state, remain robust to nuisance context, and retain the gene-level variation needed for expression analysis, three demands we call the representation trilemma. To tackle this problem, we introduce scTrilemma, a latent-bottleneck VAE that routes expression-derived variation to the embedding, the decoder, or the prior rather than forcing all of it through one embedding. It gates gene tokens by expression, routes the cell representation through the decoder, and conditions the prior on unlabeled pseudo-bulk context, under a single reconstruction objective and without target annotations or auxiliary representation losses. translated_title: scTrilemma：在单细胞表示学习中平衡身份、不变性与保真度
translated_abstract: 单细胞RNA测序表示学习本质上是无需标签的：细胞的身份、状态和上下文并非固定的训练目标，因此什么构成信号或干扰因素取决于具体分析任务。因此，单一表示必须同时保留生物学身份与状态、对干扰性上下文保持鲁棒、并保留表达分析所需的基因级变异——这三项需求我们称之为“表示三难问题”。为解决这一问题，我们提出scTrilemma，一种潜在瓶颈变分自编码器（VAE），它将源自表达的变异分别路由到嵌入、解码器或先验中，而不是强制所有变异通过单一嵌入传递。该方法依据表达量对基因标记进行门控，将细胞表示经由解码器路由，并以未标注的伪批量上下文为先验条件，整个过程仅使用单一重建目标，无需目标注释或辅助表示损失。在基于发布版本的零样本评估中……
tldr: 提出scTrilemma，一种潜在瓶颈VAE框架，通过将表达变异分别路由至嵌入、解码器和先验，在无需标签的条件下同时满足单细胞表示学习中身份保留、干扰不变性和表达保真度的“表示三难问题”。
en_tdlr: scTrilemma is a latent-bottleneck VAE that routes expression-derived variation across the embedding, decoder, and prior, simultaneously balancing identity, invariance, and fidelity in label-free single-cell representation learning.
